text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, it's starting! 
Royce-chan-sensei's Self-Produce Class~!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let's get right to it! First, try putting 
into words your vision of "what you want 
to become right now"!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, as for me... well, I guess just 
staying safe and taking it in moderation, 
probably.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nothing wrong with that! It's a truly 
universal theme! Stick with it and it'll 
sell great! Amino acids, 
glucosamine—health is a lifelong friend!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, this isn't a health food commercial... 
...By the way, what about you, O-Machi?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Umm, let's see~... Oh! Maybe I want to be 
someone who never fails at flipping crab 
omelets!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't that way too specific?! Plus, 
it needlessly gives away what you recently 
cooked for yourself!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Aha...! Let me guess! Eggs mean high 
protein! In other words, you want to 
improve your culinary skills from a 
nutritional standpoint and drastically 
overhaul your lifestyle, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Uh... T-That might actually be true!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. To tie it in with Nature-san's 
health-conscious answer...! I wonder what 
other dishes she has in mind?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Umm, let's see~... Oh! I saw a tuna omelet 
online that looked super tasty, so I'd 
like to try making that!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Tuna... Another high-protein meal!? She 
probably even took care to drain the oil. 
Mmm... Perhaps I should incorporate this 
into my own diet—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Doesn't it feel like the teacher is 
the one getting randomly enlightened 
instead?"
